topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Hey, I just found out you weren't exactly truthful about your job, and I have to say, I'm pretty shaken up about it. I know things can be tough, and maybe this was your way of dealing with it, but lying isn’t the way, you know? I’ve been thinking about us, and how much I value our friendship. I don’t want anything to come between us, and I feel like we need to talk this out. I’m here to listen, and I hope you can share what’s really going on. Let’s find a way through this together.
